title: Notes on the old shed plans
summary: The shed was built from a plan that was never copied in here, and this note says where it was kept.

# Notes on the old shed plans

The current shed was built from a set of plans drawn up years ago, and those
plans were kept on paper rather than copied into this folder. The note about
them still points at [the old shed plans](archive/shed-plans-2019.md), a
file that was never added and will not be. The link is kept on purpose so the
history of the shed stays visible, and anyone who wants the plans can ask the
person who built it.
